title: CAPTF contract v1alpha1: machinepool role outputs
description: The machinepool role's root outputs as decoded from state (common.md, machinepool.md). Every contract output must be declared. Extra, non-contract outputs are allowed and ignored. Sort order of provider_id_list is enforced by the controller, not by this schema.

provider_id.description: The scaling-group id; optional in the contract (may stay null for group-less implementations), 1-512 chars when set (infra-machinepool.md "InfraMachinePool: providerID").

provider_id_list.description: Every non-terminated member of the group, each equal to its Node's spec.providerID; may be []. At most 10000 entries, each 1-512 chars.

replicas.description: The group's desired capacity as observed at refresh; MUST equal length(provider_id_list) outside a scaling transition. The controller serialises 0 explicitly.

instances.description: Provider-defined member list; may be []. The controller caps status.instances at 1000 entries.
